questions.scenario: Give the correct biological term for each of the following descriptions.

questions.scenario:
The flow chart shows how the body responds to danger.
Danger is detected → impulses are sent to the adrenal glands → the adrenal glands secrete hormone X → the heart rate increases and glucose is released into the blood → the body is prepared for "fight or flight"
questions.scenarioAf:
Die vloeidiagram toon hoe die liggaam op gevaar reageer.
Gevaar word waargeneem → impulse word na die byniere gestuur → die byniere skei hormoon X af → die harttempo neem toe en glukose word in die bloed vrygestel → die liggaam is gereed vir "veg of vlug"

questions.q: Name hormone X.
questions.qAf: Noem hormoon X.
points: adrenaline
pointsAf: adrenalien

questions.q: Name the system that sends the impulses to the adrenal glands.
questions.qAf: Noem die stelsel wat die impulse na die byniere stuur.
points: nervous system (autonomic / sympathetic)
pointsAf: senuweestelsel (outonome / simpatiese)

questions.q: Name the organ that releases glucose into the blood under the influence of hormone X.
questions.qAf: Noem die orgaan wat onder die invloed van hormoon X glukose in die bloed vrystel.
points: liver
pointsAf: lewer

questions.q: Give THREE other effects of hormone X on the body.
questions.qAf: Gee DRIE ander uitwerkings van hormoon X op die liggaam.
points: increased breathing rate
more blood to the skeletal muscles (blood vessels to the muscles dilate)
pupils dilate / less blood to the gut and skin
pointsAf: verhoogde asemhalingstempo
meer bloed na die skeletspiere (bloedvate na die spiere verwyd)
pupille verwyd / minder bloed na die spysverteringskanaal en vel

questions.q: Explain how a faster heart rate prepares the body for "fight or flight".
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ’n vinniger harttempo die liggaam voorberei vir "veg of vlug".
points: More blood is pumped to the muscles per minute
carrying more oxygen and glucose
so the muscles can respire faster and release more energy for action
pointsAf: Meer bloed word per minuut na die spiere gepomp
wat meer suurstof en glukose dra
dus kan die spiere vinniger respireer en meer energie vir aksie vrystel

questions.scenario: The table shows the volume of sweat produced by a person resting at different air temperatures.
questions.scenarioAf: Die tabel toon die volume sweet wat ’n persoon in rus by verskillende lugtemperature produseer.

questions.q: Identify the dependent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die afhanklike veranderlike.
points: the volume of sweat produced
pointsAf: die volume sweet geproduseer

questions.q: How much sweat was produced per hour at 35 °C?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel sweet is per uur by 35 °C geproduseer?
points: 500 ml
pointsAf: 500 ml

questions.q: Describe the trend shown by the data.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die neiging wat die data toon.
points: As the air temperature increases, the volume of sweat increases
from 50 ml per hour at 20 °C to 750 ml per hour at 40 °C
pointsAf: Soos die lugtemperatuur toeneem, neem die volume sweet toe
van 50 ml per uur by 20 °C tot 750 ml per uur by 40 °C

questions.q: Explain how sweating helps to cool the body.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe sweet help om die liggaam af te koel.
points: Sweat is secreted onto the skin
it evaporates, using heat energy from the body
so heat is lost and the body temperature drops
pointsAf: Sweet word op die vel afgeskei
dit verdamp en gebruik hitte-energie van die liggaam
dus gaan hitte verlore en die liggaamstemperatuur daal

questions.q: Explain why a person should drink more water on a very hot day.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n persoon op ’n baie warm dag meer water moet drink.
points: A lot of water is lost in sweat
drinking water prevents dehydration
pointsAf: Baie water gaan in sweet verlore
om water te drink, voorkom dehidrasie

questions.scenario: The table shows the relative levels of oestrogen and progesterone in the blood of a woman during a 28-day menstrual cycle.
questions.scenarioAf: Die tabel toon die relatiewe vlakke van estrogeen en progesteroon in die bloed van ’n vrou gedurende ’n menstruele siklus van 28 dae.

questions.q: Name the structure that secretes oestrogen during the first 14 days.
questions.qAf: Noem die struktuur wat gedurende die eerste 14 dae estrogeen afskei.
points: the developing (Graafian) follicle
pointsAf: die ontwikkelende (Graafse) follikel

questions.q: Name the structure that secretes progesterone after ovulation.
questions.qAf: Noem die struktuur wat ná ovulasie progesteroon afskei.
points: corpus luteum
pointsAf: corpus luteum

questions.q: On which day in the table is the progesterone level highest?
questions.qAf: Op watter dag in die tabel is die progesteroonvlak die hoogste?
points: day 21
pointsAf: dag 21

questions.q: Explain the effect of the high oestrogen level around day 14 on the pituitary gland.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die uitwerking van die hoë estrogeenvlak omtrent dag 14 op die pituïtêre klier.
points: It inhibits the secretion of FSH
and stimulates the secretion of LH
the surge of LH causes ovulation
pointsAf: Dit inhibeer die afskeiding van FSH
en stimuleer die afskeiding van LH
die skielike styging in LH veroorsaak ovulasie

questions.q: Explain what would happen to the progesterone level after day 21 if the woman became pregnant.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik wat met die progesteroonvlak ná dag 21 sou gebeur as die vrou swanger geword het.
points: It would stay high
the corpus luteum (and later the placenta) keeps secreting progesterone
so the endometrium is maintained and menstruation does not take place
pointsAf: Dit sou hoog bly
die corpus luteum (en later die plasenta) hou aan om progesteroon af te skei
dus word die endometrium in stand gehou en menstruasie vind nie plaas nie

questions.scenario: The table compares the reproductive strategies of three animals.
questions.scenarioAf: Die tabel vergelyk die voortplantingstrategieë van drie diere.

questions.q: Explain why frogs must return to water to reproduce.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom paddas na water moet terugkeer om voort te plant.
points: Fertilisation is external, so the sperm must swim to the eggs in water
the eggs have no shell and would dry out on land
pointsAf: Bevrugting is uitwendig, dus moet die sperms in water na die eiers swem
die eiers het geen dop nie en sou op land uitdroog

questions.q: Give TWO advantages of the parental care shown by crocodiles.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele van die ouersorg wat krokodille toon.
points: The eggs and young are protected from predators
so more of the young survive
pointsAf: Die eiers en kleintjies word teen roofdiere beskerm
dus oorleef meer van die kleintjies

questions.q: Explain why dolphins can produce only one calf at a time and still survive as a species.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom dolfyne net een kalf op ’n slag kan produseer en steeds as spesie oorleef.
points: A lot of energy is invested in each calf (long gestation and much parental care)
so each calf has a high chance of surviving to adulthood
pointsAf: Baie energie word in elke kalf belê (lang dragtigheid en baie ouersorg)
dus het elke kalf ’n hoë kans om tot volwassenheid te oorleef

questions.q: Which animal in the table shows vivipary?
questions.qAf: Watter dier in die tabel toon viviparie?
points: dolphin
pointsAf: dolfyn

questions.q: Name the membrane that surrounds the embryo and contains fluid.
questions.qAf: Noem die membraan wat die embrio omring en vloeistof bevat.
points: amnion
pointsAf: amnion

questions.q: Describe THREE functions of the placenta.
questions.qAf: Beskryf DRIE funksies van die plasenta.
points: exchange of gases: oxygen to the foetus, carbon dioxide away
nutrients to the foetus and wastes (such as urea) away from it
secretes progesterone / acts as a barrier to some pathogens
pointsAf: gaswisseling: suurstof na die fetus, koolstofdioksied weg
voedingstowwe na die fetus en afvalstowwe (soos ureum) daarvandaan weg
skei progesteroon af / dien as ’n versperring vir sommige patogene

questions.q: Explain how a condom prevents both pregnancy and sexually transmitted infections.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ’n kondoom swangerskap sowel as seksueel oordraagbare infeksies voorkom.
points: It prevents sperm from entering the vagina, so fertilisation cannot take place
it is a barrier to body fluids that carry pathogens
pointsAf: Dit keer dat sperms die vagina binnegaan, dus kan bevrugting nie plaasvind nie
dit is ’n versperring vir liggaamsvloeistowwe wat patogene dra

questions.q: Name the structures in the testes where sperm are produced.
questions.qAf: Noem die strukture in die testes waar sperms geproduseer word.
points: seminiferous tubules
pointsAf: saadbuisies

questions.q: Give THREE functions of the fluid that the accessory glands add to the sperm.
questions.qAf: Gee DRIE funksies van die vloeistof wat die bykliere by die sperms voeg.
points: provides nutrients (fructose) for energy
provides a liquid medium in which the sperm can swim
is alkaline, which neutralises the acid in the urethra and vagina
pointsAf: verskaf voedingstowwe (fruktose) vir energie
verskaf ’n vloeibare medium waarin die sperms kan swem
is alkalies, wat die suur in die uretra en vagina neutraliseer

questions.q: Explain why a man with a very low sperm count may be infertile.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n man met ’n baie lae spermtelling onvrugbaar kan wees.
points: Few sperm reach the ovum
so there is little chance that one sperm will penetrate it (many sperm are needed to clear the layers around the ovum)
pointsAf: Min sperms bereik die ovum
dus is daar min kans dat een sperm dit sal binnedring (baie sperms is nodig om die lae om die ovum oop te maak)

questions.q: Give TWO male secondary sexual characteristics.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE manlike sekondêre geslagseienskappe.
points: the voice deepens
facial and body hair grows / muscles develop / shoulders broaden
pointsAf: die stem word dieper
gesigs- en liggaamshare groei / spiere ontwikkel / skouers word breër

questions.q: Describe the events from fertilisation until implantation.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die gebeure vanaf bevrugting tot innesteling.
points: Fertilisation takes place in the Fallopian tube
the acrosome of a sperm releases enzymes and one sperm enters the ovum
the haploid nuclei fuse to form a diploid zygote
the zygote divides by mitosis to form a morula and then a blastocyst
the blastocyst implants in the endometrium of the uterus
pointsAf: Bevrugting vind in die Fallopiusbuis plaas
die akrosoom van ’n sperm stel ensieme vry en een sperm gaan die ovum binne
die haploïede kerne smelt saam om ’n diploïede sigoot te vorm
die sigoot deel deur mitose om ’n morula en dan ’n blastosist te vorm
die blastosist nestel in die endometrium van die uterus in

questions.q: Draw a labelled diagram of a mature human ovum with its surrounding layers.
questions.qAf: Teken ’n benoemde diagram van ’n volwasse menslike ovum met sy omringende lae.
points: correct drawing, with any FOUR correct labels: nucleus, cytoplasm, cell membrane, jelly layer (zona pellucida), follicle cells (corona radiata)
pointsAf: korrekte tekening, met enige VIER korrekte byskrifte: kern, sitoplasma, selmembraan, jellielaag (zona pellucida), follikelselle (corona radiata)

sections.title: The nervous system and the senses

questions.scenario: A person steps on a sharp nail and immediately lifts the foot.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Persoon trap op ’n skerp spyker en lig dadelik die voet.

questions.q: Name the effector in this response.
questions.qAf: Noem die effektor in hierdie reaksie.
points: the muscles of the leg
pointsAf: die spiere van die been

questions.q: Describe the path of the impulse from the receptor to the effector.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die pad van die impuls vanaf die reseptor na die effektor.
points: receptor in the skin → sensory neuron
→ interneuron in the spinal cord
→ motor neuron → leg muscle (effector)
pointsAf: reseptor in die vel → sensoriese neuron
→ interneuron in die rugmurg
→ motoriese neuron → beenspier (effektor)

questions.q: Explain why a reflex action is faster than a voluntary action.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n refleksaksie vinniger is as ’n willekeurige aksie.
points: The impulse follows a short path through the spinal cord with few synapses
it does not go to the brain for a decision first
pointsAf: Die impuls volg ’n kort pad deur die rugmurg met min sinapse
dit gaan nie eers na die brein vir ’n besluit nie

questions.q: Name the gap between two neurons and explain how the impulse crosses it.
questions.qAf: Noem die gaping tussen twee neurone en verduidelik hoe die impuls dit oorsteek.
points: synapse
a neurotransmitter is released, diffuses across the gap and stimulates the next neuron
pointsAf: sinaps
’n neuro-oordragstof word vrygestel, diffundeer oor die gaping en stimuleer die volgende neuron

questions.q: Describe how the iris adjusts when a person walks into a dark room.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die iris aanpas wanneer ’n persoon ’n donker kamer binneloop.
points: The radial muscles of the iris contract
the circular muscles relax
the pupil dilates, so more light enters the eye
pointsAf: Die radiale spiere van die iris trek saam
die sirkelspiere ontspan
die pupil verwyd, dus kom meer lig die oog binne

questions.q: Give TWO functions of the choroid.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE funksies van die vaatvlies (choroïed).
points: its dark pigment absorbs light and prevents reflection inside the eye
its blood vessels supply oxygen and nutrients to the retina
pointsAf: sy donker pigment absorbeer lig en voorkom weerkaatsing binne die oog
sy bloedvate voorsien die retina van suurstof en voedingstowwe

questions.q: Explain what a cataract is, how it affects vision and how it is treated.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik wat ’n katarak is, hoe dit sig beïnvloed en hoe dit behandel word.
points: The lens becomes cloudy
less light reaches the retina, so vision becomes blurred
the cloudy lens is removed and replaced with an artificial lens (surgery)
pointsAf: Die lens word troebel
minder lig bereik die retina, dus word sig vaag
die troebel lens word verwyder en met ’n kunsmatige lens vervang (chirurgie)

questions.q: Name the hormone secreted by the thyroid gland that increases the metabolic rate.
questions.qAf: Noem die hormoon wat deur die skildklier afgeskei word en die metaboliese tempo verhoog.
points: thyroxin
pointsAf: tiroksien

questions.q: Describe how the body returns the thyroxin level to normal when it rises above normal.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die liggaam die tiroksienvlak terug na normaal bring wanneer dit bo normaal styg.
points: The high thyroxin level is detected (by the hypothalamus/pituitary)
the pituitary gland secretes less TSH
the thyroid gland is stimulated less
so less thyroxin is secreted
and the thyroxin level returns to normal (negative feedback)
pointsAf: Die hoë tiroksienvlak word waargeneem (deur die hipotalamus/pituïtêre klier)
die pituïtêre klier skei minder TSH af
die skildklier word minder gestimuleer
dus word minder tiroksien afgeskei
en die tiroksienvlak keer terug na normaal (negatiewe terugvoer)

questions.scenario: Learners soaked groups of 50 bean seeds in gibberellin solutions of different concentrations and recorded the percentage of seeds that germinated after 5 days.
questions.scenarioAf: Leerders het groepe van 50 boontjiesade in gibberellienoplossings van verskillende konsentrasies geweek en die persentasie sade wat ná 5 dae ontkiem het, aangeteken.

questions.q: Identify the independent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die onafhanklike veranderlike.
points: the concentration of gibberellin
pointsAf: die konsentrasie gibberellien

questions.q: State a hypothesis for this investigation.
questions.qAf: Stel ’n hipotese vir hierdie ondersoek.
points: A higher concentration of gibberellin
will increase the percentage of seeds that germinate
pointsAf: ’n Hoër konsentrasie gibberellien
sal die persentasie sade wat ontkiem, verhoog

questions.q: Explain the results of the investigation.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die resultate van die ondersoek.
points: As the gibberellin concentration increases, more seeds germinate
gibberellins activate enzymes in the seed
that break down stored food (starch) to provide energy for the growing embryo
pointsAf: Soos die gibberellienkonsentrasie toeneem, ontkiem meer sade
gibberelliene aktiveer ensieme in die saad
wat gestoorde voedsel (stysel) afbreek om energie vir die groeiende embrio te verskaf

questions.q: Give TWO factors that should be kept constant in this investigation.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE faktore wat in hierdie ondersoek konstant gehou moet word.
points: type and number of seeds
temperature / volume of solution / time soaked / light
pointsAf: soort en aantal sade
temperatuur / volume oplossing / tyd geweek / lig

questions.q: Name, in the correct order, FOUR structures that sound passes through from the pinna to the cochlea.
questions.qAf: Noem, in die korrekte volgorde, VIER strukture waardeur klank vanaf die oorskulp na die koglea beweeg.
points: auditory canal
tympanic membrane
ossicles (hammer, anvil, stirrup)
oval window
pointsAf: gehoorgang
timpaniese membraan
gehoorbeentjies (hamer, aambeeld, stiebeuel)
ovaal venster

questions.q: Describe how the semicircular canals detect movement of the head.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die halfsirkelvormige kanale beweging van die kop waarneem.
points: When the head turns, the endolymph in the canals moves
this bends the cupula and stimulates the hair cells of the cristae
impulses travel along the auditory nerve to the cerebellum
pointsAf: Wanneer die kop draai, beweeg die endolimf in die kanale
dit buig die kupula en stimuleer die haarselle van die kristae
impulse beweeg langs die gehoorsenuwee na die serebellum

questions.q: Explain why a middle-ear infection can cause hearing loss, and how grommets help.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n middeloorinfeksie gehoorverlies kan veroorsaak, en hoe grommets help.
points: Fluid (pus) collects in the middle ear
so the ossicles cannot vibrate freely and less sound is passed on
a grommet in the tympanic membrane drains the fluid and equalises the pressure
pointsAf: Vloeistof (etter) versamel in die middeloor
dus kan die gehoorbeentjies nie vrylik vibreer nie en minder klank word oorgedra
’n grommet in die timpaniese membraan dreineer die vloeistof en maak die druk gelyk

questions.q:
Describe the events from fertilisation to implantation and the role of the placenta during pregnancy, and explain how the body responds when the body temperature rises above normal.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf die gebeure vanaf bevrugting tot innesteling en die rol van die plasenta tydens swangerskap, en verduidelik hoe die liggaam reageer wanneer die liggaamstemperatuur bo normaal styg.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points:
Fertilisation and implantation (max 6)
Sperm swim through the cervix and uterus to the Fallopian tube
the acrosome releases enzymes that dissolve a way into the ovum
only one sperm enters the ovum
the haploid nuclei fuse to form a diploid zygote
the zygote divides by mitosis to form a morula
and then a blastocyst
which implants in the endometrium of the uterus

The placenta (max 5)
Forms from the chorion (villi) and the endometrium
oxygen and nutrients diffuse from the mother’s blood to the foetus
carbon dioxide and urea diffuse from the foetus to the mother
the blood of the mother and foetus does not mix
it secretes progesterone to maintain the pregnancy
it is connected to the foetus by the umbilical cord

Temperature rise (max 6)
The hypothalamus detects the rise in body temperature
blood vessels in the skin dilate (vasodilation)
more blood flows to the skin surface
so more heat is lost by radiation
sweat glands become more active
the evaporation of sweat removes heat
the body temperature returns to normal (negative feedback)
pointsAf:
Bevrugting en innesteling (maks 6)
Sperms swem deur die serviks en uterus na die Fallopiusbuis
die akrosoom stel ensieme vry wat ’n pad in die ovum oplos
net een sperm gaan die ovum binne
die haploïede kerne smelt saam om ’n diploïede sigoot te vorm
die sigoot deel deur mitose om ’n morula te vorm
en dan ’n blastosist
wat in die endometrium van die uterus innestel

Die plasenta (maks 5)
Vorm uit die chorion (vlokke) en die endometrium
suurstof en voedingstowwe diffundeer van die moeder se bloed na die fetus
koolstofdioksied en ureum diffundeer van die fetus na die moeder
die bloed van die moeder en fetus meng nie
dit skei progesteroon af om die swangerskap in stand te hou
dit is deur die naelstring aan die fetus verbind

Temperatuurstyging (maks 6)
Die hipotalamus neem die styging in liggaamstemperatuur waar
bloedvate in die vel verwyd (vasodilatasie)
meer bloed vloei na die veloppervlak
dus gaan meer hitte deur straling verlore
sweetkliere word meer aktief
die verdamping van sweet verwyder hitte
die liggaamstemperatuur keer terug na normaal (negatiewe terugvoer)

questions.q: Synthesis
questions.qAf: Sintese
points: Relevance (1): all the information is about fertilisation, the placenta and temperature regulation; nothing irrelevant
Logical sequence (1): ideas are in a logical order in each part
Comprehensive (1): at least 4/6 for fertilisation, 3/5 for the placenta and 4/6 for temperature
pointsAf: Relevansie (1): al die inligting gaan oor bevrugting, die plasenta en temperatuurregulering; niks irrelevant nie
Logiese volgorde (1): idees is in ’n logiese volgorde in elke deel
Omvattend (1): ten minste 4/6 vir bevrugting, 3/5 vir die plasenta en 4/6 vir temperatuur
